subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do workflow-security owners approve the revised third-party action code, including the `openai/codex-action` update, for the workflows that receive repository credentials and publish or attest artifacts?
rationale: This is an intentional supply-chain trust decision over upstream action behavior and credentials exposure; it cannot be resolved by a mechanical change to the Dependabot branch.

options.title: Approve after targeted upstream review
options.body: Review the pinned release commits and direct Codex runtime contract, then accept the updates once final-head workflow evidence is complete.

options.title: Split credential-bearing pins
options.body: Keep low-risk workflow updates separate and defer action revisions used with private keys, tokens, registry credentials, or OpenAI API keys for dedicated security review.

options.title: Pause this dependency group
options.body: Close or defer this broad group update if a security owner does not want to accept the combined action changes as one trust-boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted upstream review
recommendation.body: Review the pinned release commits and direct Codex runtime contract, then accept the updates once final-head workflow evidence is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-wide credential-bearing workflow changes need a repository-level workflow-security decision owner.
